description: List issues. Filter by --status if needed.

assignee.description: Keep only issues assigned to this username.

fields.description: Return only these top-level fields (plus id keys), narrowing the response further.

label.description: Keep only issues with a label whose title contains this (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Return at most N issues after filtering/sorting.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

sort.description: Sort by a field; prefix '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt').

name: gitflic_issue_list
